{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.58

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Calculate sunrise and sunset time.

|s1= date call [[BIS_fnc_sunriseSunsetTime]]

|p1= date: [[Array]]  - date in format [[Date]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Number]] - [sunriseTime, sunsetTime]. Returns special values when the world position is behind the polar cicle: [0,-1] - polar summer (i.e., no sunset), [-1,0] - polar winter (i.e., no sunrise).

|x1= <sqf>private _sunriseSunsetTime = date call BIS_fnc_sunriseSunsetTime; // get sunrise/sunset time for the current date</sqf>

|seealso= [[sunOrMoon]]
}}
